x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"plan_template_references\":[{\"plan_template_item_id\":54,\"type\":\"specification_section\",\"payload\":{\"drawing_revision_id\":53,\"file_version_id\":54,\"document_management_document_reference\":{\"collection_id\":\"123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000\",\"container_id\":\"123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174001\"},\"specification_section_id\":55,\"submittal_log_id\":65,\"generic_tool_item_id\":56,\"form_id\":57,\"image_id\":60,\"meeting_id\":58,\"observation_item_id\":59}}]}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/action_plans/plan_template_references/bulk_create?completion_mode=SOME_STRING_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
